title: Supervisor spec
description: What a supervisor checks and how. Write every sentence a model reads to the supervisor, in the second person. See ts/packages/supervisor/README.md.

id.description: A stable name for the spec, such as send_email. A stored verdict names the spec it answered.

task.description: What the supervisor checks, in a few words: the tool call it reads before it runs, or the session it audits. The prompt says 'You are checking <task>'.

preamble.description: Markdown, to the supervisor: what the agent is doing, what a wrong verdict costs and what a right one is worth. It goes into the system prompt under its own heading.

checklist.description: The items, in the order the supervisor should think about them. Ids are stable: verdicts are keyed by them.

id.description: Stable once a verdict has been stored under it.

title.description: A few words a person reads beside a tick or a cross.

lookFor.description: To the supervisor: what to check, what ok means, which cases pass, and what the analysis should cite, with an invented example.

severity.description: block: a failed item stops the call. warn: it is recorded and never stops anything.

guidance.description: To the agent: what to read or do when this item fails. A host shows it beside the analysis when it sends a call back.

answeredBy.description: host: the host answers this item in code, and the model is not asked. Leave it out for the model to answer.
